CLIMATE RESILIENT AND SUSTAINABLE
  CITY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 23, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Keisha Gaines, Chair  Pearl Hanks, Commissioner
Rey Gonzales, Vice Chair  Kirk Kunihiro, Commissioner
Michael Bennett, Commissioner  Pete Marsh, Commissioner
Holland Brown, Commissioner  Charles McCullough, Commissioner
Hilda Gaytan, Commissioner  Christina Sergy, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54891  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Climate Resilient and Sustainable
  City Commission meeting of Thursday, February 26, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54892  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Long Beach City College
  on a Climate Ready Workforce.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54893  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from City staff on the draft
  Urban Forest Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54894  Recommendation to review the Ad Hoc Committee report on an Electric Vehicle
  Battery Reuse and Recycling Hub Feasibility Study and determine whether to
  forward it to City Council for consideration.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54895  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54896  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from City staff on Earth Month
  and announcements and resources from the Office of Climate Action and

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
